name: Leaf Blade
description: Melee Spell Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage. This attack scores a critical hit on a roll of 18-20. This attack has advantage against any creature currently under the influence of the creature's Spores ability.
